attributes.name: Revert | Pineapple Haze | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: Pineapple Haze is a sativa dominant hybrid (70% sativa/30% indica) strain created as a cross between the insanely delicious PineappleX Haze strains.The onset hits you almost immediately with a euphoric and uplifted cerebral stimulation that gives you a jolt of creative energy with motivation to get outside and move. This cerebral energy has almost no ceiling and no sedative effects, making it perfect for outdoor activities like hiking or swimming. In fact, the only indica effect you'll feel is a mild relaxation that leads to complete pain relief in both the mind and body. Because of these powerful uplifting effects, Pineapple Haze is often used to treat chronic fatigue, PTSD, mild to moderate cases of depression, and chronic pain.

attributes.name: Revert | Godfather OG | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: Godfather OG, also known as "Godfather," "The Don of All OG's," and "OG Godfather," is a potent indica marijuana strain made by crossing XXX OG and Alpha OG. The effects of this strain are sedating and relaxing. This strain features a flavor profile that is spicy and kushy, with undertones of subtle grape. Consumers with a low THC tolerance should only smoke Godfather OG in small doses due to its high THC levels, which hover around 28%. This strain won 1st place for Best Indica at the 2013 Cannabis Cup in Los Angeles.

attributes.name: Revert | Northern Lights | Big Buds | 14g
attributes.body: Northern Lights is a legendary indica strain, known for its iconic, piney sweetness and subtle hints of earth and spice. Northern Lights delivers a deeply relaxing and dreamy body high that’s stood the test of time. Well-cured buds shimmer with dense trichome coverage, releasing a classic, old-school aroma when broken apart. Its smoke is smooth, rich, and comforting, perfect for melting away tension. A staple for seasoned indica lovers, Northern Lights offers an enduring calm and blissful euphoria that lingers long after the exhale.

attributes.name: Revert | Crumble Cake | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: Sink into serene bliss with Crumble Cake, a luxurious sun-grown indica-hybrid crafted from the fusion of Wedding Cake and Ice Cream Cake, celebrated for its soothing effects, decadent flavors, and balanced relaxation. Grown under natural sunlight to intensify its potency and terpene complexity. Available in 3.5g pre-packaged flower that offers a slow-burning, creamy smoke ideal for unwinding, easing tension, and enjoying a tranquil yet uplifting evening.

attributes.name: Revert | Lemon Drop | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: Brighten your day with Lemon Drop, a refreshing sun-grown sativa-hybrid crafted from a zesty lineage, celebrated for its invigorating effects, tangy flavors, and uplifting clarity. Cultivated under natural sunlight to enhance its potency and terpene vibrancy, available in a 3.5g pre-packaged flower that delivers a slow-burning, crisp smoke perfect for sparking creativity, boosting energy, and enjoying a lively yet balanced experience.

attributes.name: Revert | Strawberry Amnesia | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: A powerful and uplifting flower from Dinafem Seeds, Strawberry Amnesia is a strain made in sativa heaven. Bred from Strawberry Cough and Amnesia, this strain delivers the familiar sweet strawberry and earthy flavors of its parents. Having the typical energizing and euphoric effects of a sativa, Strawberry Amnesia also induces the calming body high from its distant indica relatives. The dark green buds of Strawberry Amnesia are very dense and heavily coated in resin, so this potent sativa should be handled with caution.

attributes.name: TROP CHERRY DIME BAG PREMIUM PURPLE FLOWER
attributes.body:
TROP CHERRY DIME BAG PREMIUM PURPLE FLOWER HYBRID 33%THC


Trop Cherry, which won 1st Place (Best Licensed) - 2025 NY Craft Flower Cup, 2nd Place (Best of Cup) - 2025 NY Craft Flower Cup, and 3rd place at the 2025 Headstash Bowl for flower, is bright, bold, energizing, and euphoric. Floral yet citrus, with a burst of dank tangerine and rich cherry.

attributes.name: Blue Dream | Smalls | 7g
attributes.body: The Untitled Blue Dream 7g (Smalls) offers a balanced and versatile experience, perfect for both novice and experienced consumers. A cross of Blueberry and Haze, this hybrid delivers a sweet, berry aroma with earthy undertones. Its terpene profile, rich in myrcene, pinene, and caryophyllene, provides uplifting, euphoric effects that promote creativity and relaxation. Blue Dream is known for its ability to relieve stress and anxiety while enhancing focus and mood, making it ideal for daytime or evening use. These smalls deliver the same great effects and flavor as full-sized buds, offering an affordable option without sacrificing quality.

attributes.name: Smoakland X - Grape Ape - 28g
attributes.body: A heavy-hitting Indica famous for its deep aroma of sweet grapes and earthy skunk. It provides a weighted, full-body relaxation that melts away tension and quiets the mind. Ideal for late-night sessions and achieving a state of total tranquility.

attributes.name: Revert | Forbidden Kush | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: Immerse yourself in deep tranquility with Forbidden Kush, a potent sun-grown indica derived from the cross of Forbidden Fruit and OG Kush, renowned for its profound relaxation, rich flavors, and sedative embrace. Cultivated under natural sunlight to enhance its potency and terpene intensity. Available in 3.5g pre-packaged flower that delivers a slow-burning, lush smoke perfect for unwinding, melting stress, and drifting into restorative sleep.

attributes.name: Neon Flamingo | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: Neon Flamingo is a vibrant hybrid known for its fruity, citrus-forward flavor and uplifting effects. It delivers a clear-headed cerebral buzz with light body relaxation, making it great for daytime use, social settings, and creative tasks. Often used for stress, fatigue, and mood enhancement, it keeps users energized without heaviness.

attributes.name: Dante's Rainbow | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: Dante’s Inferno × Cadillac Rainbow is a vibrant hybrid that blends dessert sweetness with bold, gassy complexity. Bright candy-like citrus and fruity notes lead the way, followed by creamy fuel and a soft floral spice on the exhale. The high opens with an uplifting rush of euphoria and creativity, then eases into a calm, balanced body feel that keeps things smooth and functional. Ideal for lifting the mood, sparking inspiration, or enjoying a flavorful, feel-good session any time of day.

attributes.name: Lemon Venom | Flower | 3.5g
attributes.body: Leal's Lemon Venom is a potent indica hybrid strain known for its potent relaxation and citrusy flavor profile. It's described as having a zesty lemon aroma with subtle earthy undertones, creating a smooth and flavorful smoke. This strain is often used for evening relaxation and stress relief, providing a calming body high with a clear mind.

attributes.name: Smoakland X - Maui Wowie - 28g
attributes.body:
A legendary island sativa bursting with sweet pineapple and tropical fruit flavors. Maui

Wowie delivers a light, happy, and energizing high that lifts your mood without

overwhelming the body. Smooth, flavorful, and sunshine-soaked, it’s perfect for daytime

sessions, creative flow, or keeping the vibes bright and carefree.

attributes.body:
A classic East Coast sativa known for its sharp diesel aroma and bright citrus bite. NY Diesel
delivers an uplifting, fast-acting head high that sparks creativity, focus, and motivation.
Bold, gassy flavor meets a smooth, energizing buzz—perfect for daytime sessions,
social vibes, or powering through your to-do list.

attributes.name: DEVIL'S DRIP DIME BAG .7 GRAM
attributes.body: The perfect blend of Sherb and Red Pop, this relaxing and euphoric frosted-purple strain has a fruity yet nutty undertone.

attributes.name: Funk Juice | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: Funk Juice is a cross between Focaccia x Jamba Juice strains with a sedating, happy high. Prominent terpens include b-Caryophyllene, a-Humulene, Limonene and a-Bisabolol. Funk Juice has cinnamon, hops, orange and chamomile notes.

attributes.name: OG KUSH
attributes.body: OG Kush, a legendary strain that emerged in Florida during the early '90s, is famed for its complex aroma blending fuel, skunk, and spice. This iconic hybrid, which involves genetics from Northern California, Chemdawg, Lemon Thai, and Hindu Kush, is best known for its robust lemon-pine-fuel scent and a high-THC profile delivering both cerebral and physical effects. Often referred to as “Original Gangster,” OG Kush represents the genetic backbone of many West Coast strains, giving rise to famous varieties like GSC and Headband. Enjoyed later in the day, it effectively helps alleviate stress, anxiety, and pain, while providing a satisfying munchies kick.

attributes.name: Revert | Cherry Swirl | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: Cherry Swirl is a smooth, sun-grown hybrid with rich cherry sweetness layered over subtle earth and cream. This strain delivers a balanced experience that starts with a gentle cerebral lift and settles into an easy, relaxed body feel. Approachable and versatile, Cherry Swirl is well-suited for daytime or early evening sessions when you want flavor, clarity, and calm without feeling weighed down.

attributes.name: Revert | Sour Glue | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: Elevate your day with Sour Glue, a vibrant sun-grown sativa renowned for its uplifting effects, zesty flavors, and energizing clarity. Cultivated under natural sunlight to heighten its potency and terpene vibrancy. Available in 3.5g pre-packaged flower that delivers a slow-burning, crisp smoke perfect for boosting creativity, enhancing focus, and enjoying an active, inspired mindset. Sour Glue presents a lively and intricate flavor profile, blending citrusy lemon with hints of earthy pine and a refreshing minty finish, complemented by a smooth, herbal aftertaste. Its aromatic smoke releases bursts of tangy fruit and subtle spice, captivating those who enjoy a bright, invigorating taste with a clean exhale.

attributes.name: Skyworld - Melted Strawberries - 3.5g Jar
attributes.body:
Melted Strawberries is a sativa dominant cross of GMO x Strawberry Guava. The flavors include Ripe berries with creamy undertones. Dominant terpenes are β-Myrcene (1.25%), β-Caryophyllene (0.55%), Limonene (0.40%).


Skyworld grows premium indoor flower with a focus on craft quality and terpene expression.

attributes.name: The Botanist | Gasoline Lolipop | Flower | 3.5g
attributes.body: We believe growing quality cannabis is an art. Our mission is to deliver high quality cannabis at affordable prices by combining traditional craftsmanship with modern cultivation techniques.

attributes.body: Kings & Queens Hell Cat #15 is a big buds flower available in 3.5g. 25.273% THC, 0% CBD.

attributes.name: Blueberry Kush | Smalls | 3.5g
attributes.body: Blueberry Kush, also known as "Blueberry OG Kush," is a potent indica marijuana strain made by crossing Blueberry and OG Kush. This strain produces effects that slowly brings on a heavy body sensation, helping consumers forget their stress and relax. Blueberry Kush is a popular choice for evening use, as its dreamy effects will float you into a deep sleep. Medical marijuana patients choose this strain to help relieve symptoms associated with insomnia and stress.

attributes.name: Skyworld - White Apple Runtz - 3.5g Jar - Flower
attributes.body: This hybrid blends crisp apple candy, creamy sweetness, and light tropical citrus for a smooth, dessert-like experience—ideal for sparking creativity, lifting your mood, or cruising through a chill afternoon.

attributes.name: Blueberry Sugar | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: Blueberry Sugar is a sweet, terpene-rich hybrid that delivers classic berry flavor with a smooth, sugary finish. Cultivated indoors by Kings & Queens, these large, dense buds offer aromas of ripe blueberries, subtle citrus, and light floral notes. The effects are relaxing yet uplifting, providing a gentle body calm paired with a happy, easygoing head high. Perfect for unwinding without feeling heavy, this strain is ideal for flavor lovers seeking premium indoor flower with balanced effects.

attributes.name: Rain Drops | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: 1937 Cannabis is a big buds flower available in 3.5g. 19.46% THC, 0% CBD.

attributes.name: Untitled - Durban Poison 3.5g
attributes.body: Untitled’s 3.5g jar of Durban Poison delivers a pure sativa experience rooted in its South African heritage. Known for its sweet, spicy aroma and oversized resinous buds, this landrace strain is packed with terpinolene, ocimene, and myrcene—creating an invigorating terpene profile that smells of licorice, pine, and citrus zest. The effects are fast-acting and energizing, offering clear-headed focus and a creative spark perfect for daytime use or social outings.

attributes.name: Poptart | Value Line Flower | 3.5g
attributes.body:
Flavors/Aromas: Hops, Mango, Diesel
Experience: Indica-like, Relaxed
Boosts: TV, Stress Relief, Music

Zippy, sour-sharp fruit balanced out with some solid earthiness. The moderate THC in this indica-like smoke keeps things chill and easy.

The original Poptart cultivar has famous parents in Sour OG Affie mixed with Lemon Cake. In this one, the sour definitely prevails over the sweet, with some potent green apple and hops flavors shining through. The zingy front end is grounded with a solid dose of myrcene, making this a more indica-like smoke; good body buzz can turn into couchlock. Moderate THC keeps things fairly mellow, but if you've got a busy night planned, maybe keep this in the jar for a chilled-out evening.

attributes.name: Glitter Bomb | Standard Flower | 3.5g
attributes.body:
Flavors/Aromas: Mojito, Appletini, Lemon Sorbet
Experience: Sativa-like, Upbeat
Boosts: Creativity, Music

A refreshing blast of crisp, cool, leafy-green chill, like your favorite summertime cocktail. Floral terpenes like farnesene and ocimene add an icy bite to a peppery-hoppy background.

attributes.name: Mac Flurry | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body:
Mac Flurry whips together creamy sweetness and vanilla frosting with a swirl of citrus and earthy gas. The high is smooth and balanced—uplifting the mood with euphoric clarity while easing the body into a gentle calm. Perfect for sparking creativity, sharing laughs, or keeping the vibe light and easy.

Flavors: Sweet cream, vanilla frosting, citrus gas, earthy funk

Effects: Euphoric, balanced, mellow body buzz

Great For: Social hangs, creative sparks, daytime relaxation

attributes.name: Revert | Grapelato | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: Grapelato is a smooth, flavor-forward hybrid that blends sweet grape and creamy dessert notes with subtle earthiness. This strain delivers a relaxed, uplifting experience that starts with a light cerebral buzz and settles into a calm, comfortable body feel. Easygoing and balanced, Grapelato is great for social settings, creative moments, or unwinding without feeling heavy.

attributes.name: Blueberry | Big Buds | 14g
attributes.body: Blueberry Frosting is a terpene-rich cannabis strain recognized for its sweet berry aroma and smooth flavor. The terpene profile often highlights fresh blueberry notes layered with creamy undertones that create a dessert-like smoking experience. Dense buds coated in trichomes give the flower a frosty appearance that contributes to the strain’s name. Customers exploring larger cannabis flower options at Crush Dispensary in Albany NY often choose Blueberry Frosting for its sweet terpene expression and relaxing effects. Many consumers enjoy the calming body sensation paired with gentle mental uplift. For shoppers browsing flavorful 14g cannabis flower in Albany, Blueberry Frosting offers a sweet and aromatic option available at Crush Dispensary.

attributes.name: Boukét | Cap Junky | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: Our experts optimize every step of the growing process, unlocking the magic of what legacy genetics have to offer: smooth flavor, powerful terpene profiles, and effects you feel in full color – whether you’re picking up a jar for a friend or giving yourself your flowers.

attributes.name: Boukét | Honeymoon Diesel | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: Bouket is a love letter to New York's rich cannabis history. Its name is a nod to its legacy: the jazz-soaked underground of Harlem during Prohibition, when "bouquet" was a codeword for cannabis. We honor those roots, and how they've grown across time from Harlem parlors of the Roaring '20s to downtown clubs of the '80s and '90s; from hush-hush delivery services to full cultural bloom.

attributes.name: Thai Sunrise | Flower | 70g
attributes.body: Find is your everyday cannabis flower at a great price you’ve been looking for—whether you’re picking the perfect supply for good times with good friends or savoring a solo smoke. However you want it, Find always gives you the quality and quantity you’re looking for so you can enjoy some great green—for less green!

attributes.name: GROW 716 - PINYATTI - FLOWER - 3.5G
attributes.body:
Pinyatti is a flavorful hybrid that blends sharp pine freshness with subtle candy sweetness for a uniquely balanced smoke. The aroma opens with bright pine needles and herbal kush, followed by hints of sweet citrus and light gas. Loud but refreshing, it offers a crisp terp profile that stands out from typical dessert strains.


The high comes on with a clear-headed, euphoric lift that boosts mood and focus, then settles into a calm, steady body relaxation. Ideal for daytime or early evening use, Pinyatti delivers functional effects with classic flavor appeal.

attributes.name: Lemon Meringue | Big Buds | 3.5g
attributes.body: Meet PharmaCann’s first nursery brand, where innovation is incubated and real-time feedback is welcome. The PC Nursery Brand was created for cultivated phenotypes from trusted genetics to prosper in a small batch environment for real-time consumer feedback before its brand placement.

attributes.name: JETPACKS - ICE CREAM CAKE - PREGROUND INF FLOWER - 3.5G
attributes.body: Indulge in a heavy-hitting, dessert-meets-fuel experience with Jetpacks Jetfuel Ice Cream Cake Infused Ground Flower, a premium ready-to-use blend crafted for maximum flavor and potency. This infused mix combines the gassy intensity of Jetfuel with the rich, creamy sweetness of Ice Cream Cake, delivering a layered profile that’s both loud and luxuriously smooth. On the nose and palate, expect a bold fusion of diesel fuel, vanilla cream, sweet cake batter, earthy spice, and subtle sugary frosting notes. The infusion enhances both terpene richness and overall strength, creating a dense, flavorful smoke that burns consistently and hits with noticeable depth. Effects lean strongly relaxing, starting with a gentle euphoric lift before melting into a full-body calm that’s ideal for unwinding. The combination of gas and dessert strains makes this a go-to for evening sessions or when you want something potent and comforting.

attributes.name: ROLLING GREEN - PERM LI HI - FLOWER - 3.5G
ROLLING GREEN - SHERB CREAM PIE - FLOWER - 3.5G
attributes.body: Sherb Cream Pie blends bright citrus with a creamy sweetness and soft floral notes. The experience settles in smoothly, offering a soothing, slightly indulgent feel that relaxes the body while keeping the mood lifted. A great choice for easing into a calm, comfortable evening.

attributes.name: ROLLING GREEN - ALIEN PEBBLES - FLOWER - 3.5G
attributes.body:
Take your evening session to another world with Alien Pebbles, an indica-dominant hybrid born from the stellar genetics of Alien OG and Fruity Pebbles OG. This flavorful cultivar delivers a sweet and fruity aroma accented by bright citrus notes, light pine, and subtle herbal undertones, creating a smooth and enjoyable smoking experience from start to finish.


Alien Pebbles is known for its relaxing, slightly hazy effects that gently ease the body while lifting the mood just enough to keep the experience pleasant and carefree. Ideal for unwinding after a long day, settling into a favorite show, or simply zoning out and letting stress melt away, this strain strikes a comfortable balance between relaxation and subtle mental uplift. Packaged in a convenient 3.5G format, Alien Pebbles is a flavorful choice for those seeking a mellow, end-of-day escape.

ROLLING GREEN - WRANK - FLOWER - 3.5G
attributes.body: Wrank combines sharp citrus with a noticeable spice and earthy backbone. The effect is grounded but not sluggish, delivering a steady, composed relaxation with a slight mental lift to keep you engaged.

gelato sunset | Big Buds | 14g
attributes.body: Cannabis flower is rich in trichomes, which are the resin glands containing cannabinoids and terpenes, that produce effects ranging from relaxing to stimulating depending on the potency and ratios of each active compound. Effects can usually be felt immediately and last 2-4 hours typically with a peak reached within 30 minutes to an hour.

attributes.name: Island Time Kush | Big Buds | 14g
attributes.body: Slip into vacation mode with Island Time Kush, a flavorful indica-dominant hybrid that captures the essence of chill. Born from the tropical potency of Banana Punch GMO #2 and the decadent depth of EZBake AF, this strain wraps you in a warm, fruity embrace reminiscent of a beachside dessert. Expect waves of euphoria and joy, balanced with a deep, soothing body high that melts tension without anchoring you to the couch.

attributes.name: Tropical Treats | Big Buds | 14g
attributes.body: Tropical Treats is an elite sativa that’s truly a crowd-pleaser! A masterful spin on wedding cake crosses, this strain boasts huge yields of dense, glittering buds that are a breeze to trim. With a rich, sweet tropical flavor reminiscent of a pineapple citrus pastry, each puff transports you to a personal island of relieving, uplifted euphoria. High in potency yet creative and functional, Tropical Treats delivers a lasting, blissful high that will have you feeling like you’re basking in a tropical paradise.

attributes.name: BOUKET - PINEAPPLE KUSH (BIG BUDS) - FLOWER - 3.5G
attributes.body: Pineapple Kush is a popular indica-dominant hybrid strain (roughly 80% indica/20% sativa) known for its sweet, tropical pineapple flavor mixed with earthy OG Kush undertones. It offers a relaxing body high paired with gentle, creative euphoria, making it popular for stress, pain, and anxiety relief.

attributes.name: 1937 - CITRON GIVRE - FLOWER - 3.5G
attributes.body: Citron Givré provides a complex high that starts with cerebral stimulation and transitions into deep, intense body relaxation. It is known to be quite potent, making it suitable for users looking for a happy, uplifting, yet calming experience. It is also known to cause significant munchies.

attributes.name: 1937 - DUCT TAPE - FLOWER - 3.5G
attributes.body:
Duct Tape is an Indica strain created by crossing the infamous Original Glue X Do-Si-Dos strains. If you’re looking for a unique flavor and a super potent high, Duct Tape is totally the bud for you. This lovely lady packs a sweet and chocolatey flavor into each and every toke, accented by a heavy diesel exhale that can leave you coughing. The aroma is very similar, with an earthy diesel overtone that’s accented by spicy chocolate and nuts.


1937 Flower is hand-picked and hand-selected. Then undergoes an extended cure process, enhancing the terpene profiles with richer flavors and deep aromatics.

attributes.name: 1937 - MELON HEAD - FLOWER - 3.5G
attributes.body: Melonheadz is an indica cannabis strain bred by Clout King. Melonheadz is a cross of Watermelon Zkittelz and Airheadz. Melonheadz has an aroma of watermelon candy and sweet gas. Melonheadz dominant terpenes are Linalool, B-Caryophyllene and Limonene.

attributes.name: DANK - VANILLA KUSH - FLOWER - 14G
attributes.body: Vanilla Kush is best suited for experienced users who can still maintain some activity despite its potent effects. Users commonly report feelings of euphoria and happiness with Vanilla Kush. This strain effectively addresses mental conditions and arthritis pain. As expected, it features a vanilla taste and aroma, complemented by sweet lavender notes. Because of its strong high, beginners and occasional users may want to approach with caution. However, it's ideal for those seeking a pleasant, soothing body high.

attributes.name: DOOBIE LABS - BLUE DREAM - FLOWER - 3.5G
attributes.body: Blue Dream is a legendary, sativa-dominant hybrid (60% sativa / 40% indica) born in Santa Cruz, California. Created by crossing Blueberry with Haze, it is universally loved for its sweet berry aroma and perfectly balanced, functional high that provides an uplifting cerebral boost while keeping the body completely relaxed

HOUSE OF SACCI - BISCOTTI PANCAKES DIME BAG - FLOWER - 0.7G
SUPERDOPE- BUBBLEGUM POPPERZ - FLOWER - 3.5G
attributes.body: Bubble Gum Popperz is an evenly balanced hybrid strain (50% indica/50% sativa) created through crossing the potent Superdope X HiTech X Fear of Boof strains. A delicious bud with a soothing, heavy high, Bubble Gum Popperz is a great choice for any hybrid lover who wants a true stone with their bud. The high settles in with a slow build of effects, beginning with a calming tingle felt in the back of the head and neck. This tingle will soon work its way forward, leaving your eyes feeling heavy and drooping and your body buzzy yet filled with relaxation.

attributes.name: SUPERDOPE- LEMON POPPERZ - FLOWER - 3.5G
attributes.body:
Lemon Popperz, an exotic blend of Gelato 41 crossed with Lemon Tree, gives off candy terps with the a “41 lemon funk” profile.


Each fluffy yet dense popcorn-shaped nug boasts a forest green hue, vibrant orange hairs, and thick milky trichomes, showcasing Super Dope’s signature quality. The aroma hits with fresh linen and black pepper, while the flavor combines bubblegum candy, licorice spice, and a subtle gas undertone for a rich, complex smoke.

attributes.name: SUPERDOPE- PLUM POPPERZ - FLOWER - 3.5G
attributes.body: Plum Popperz is an indica-leaning hybrid by Super Dope. It crosses a Runtz cut with Zkittlez. Known for sweet, creamy candy flavors, it produces rich purple buds and offers heavily relaxing, euphoric effects.

attributes.name: ROLLING GREEN - BATTLE AXE - FLOWER - 3.5G
attributes.body: Battle Axe is a potent indica-hybrid with bold flavors of earthy kush, diesel, citrus peel, and peppery spice. The high starts with a euphoric head buzz that boosts mood before settling into deep body relaxation. Strong but balanced, it’s a great choice for evening use, especially for customers who enjoy classic OG-style gas and a smooth, calming finish.

attributes.name: ROLLING GREEN - MODIFIED GRAPE - FLOWER - 3.5G
attributes.body: Modified Grape brings a rich grape-forward sweetness layered with citrus brightness and a touch of earthy spice. The experience builds gradually, offering a relaxed, steady calm with a subtle mood lift that keeps things comfortable and easygoing without becoming overly heavy. This  indica-dominant hybrid strain, created by crossing GMO and Purple Punch. It is known for a pungent aroma of sweet grapes and gasoline, producing dense, dark green buds with purple hues, tailored for deep, savory relaxation and evening use

5.     Spiciness: Sour Diesel can have a subtle spiciness, with hints of pepper or spice that linger on the palate.

Overall, Sour Diesel offers a robust and multi-dimensional flavor profile that combines diesel fuel, citrus, skunkiness, herbal, and spicy notes. Its unique taste, coupled with its potent effects, has made it a favorite among cannabis enthusiasts on the East Coast and beyond.
